title: End-of-phase action
statement: For a register index $r$ among $m$ work tapes, states $c_R$ and $n_x$, and an optional Boolean value $r_d$, define an action as follows: if $r_d$ is present, leave the work tape unchanged, move its head one cell to the right, and enter state $c_R$; if $r_d$ is absent, leave the work tape unchanged, move its head one cell to the left, and enter state $n_x$. In either case, the other action components are those specified by the register-action construction.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is an index among the $m$ work tapes
caveat: The referenced register-action construction is not included among the supplied definitions, so the full action components cannot be stated precisely.
